mush.definition:
n. cornmeal boiled in water
n. a journey by dogsled
v. drive (a team of dogs or a dogsled)
mush.translation:
n. 浓粥, 感伤的话, 软块
vi. 带狗撬在雪上前进
interj. 走, 前进

mush-mouthed.translation: adj. <美><非正>张口结舌的，结结巴巴的

mushed.definition:
v drive (a team of dogs or a dogsled)
v travel with a dogsled
mushed.translation: v. 软而稠的混合物或块( mush的过去式和过去分词 ); 糊状物; 玉米粥; 脆弱的感情

mushenge.translation: [地名] [刚果民主共和国] 穆申盖

musher.definition: n. a traveler who drives (or travels with) a dog team

mushers.definition: n. a traveler who drives (or travels with) a dog team
mushers.translation: 赶狗拉雪橇的人（ mush的变形 ）

mushes.definition:
n any soft or soggy mass
n cornmeal boiled in water
n writing or music that is excessively sweet and sentimental
n a journey by dogsled
v drive (a team of dogs or a dogsled)
v travel with a dogsled
mushes.translation: v. 软而稠的混合物或块( mush的第三人称单数 ); 糊状物; 玉米粥; 脆弱的感情

mushies.definition:
plural of mushy
s. having the consistency of mush
mushies.translation: (mushy 的复数) a. 浓粥状的, 含糊不清, 感伤的

mushily.translation: adv. 浓粥状地, 糊状地, 感伤地

mushiness.definition:
n. a mushy pulpy softness
n. falsely emotional in a maudlin way
mushiness.translation: n. 糊状物; 脆弱的感情, 感伤

mushing.definition:
v drive (a team of dogs or a dogsled)
v travel with a dogsled
mushing.translation: v. 软而稠的混合物或块( mush的现在分词 ); 糊状物; 玉米粥; 脆弱的感情

mushroom.definition:
n. common name for an edible agaric (contrasting with the inedible toadstool)
n. mushrooms and related fleshy fungi (including toadstools, puffballs, morels, coral fungi, etc.)
n. any of various fleshy fungi of the subdivision Basidiomycota consisting of a cap at the end of a stem arising from an underground mycelium
n. a large cloud of rubble and dust shaped like a mushroom and rising into the sky after an explosion (especially of a nuclear bomb)
mushroom.translation:
n. 蘑菇形物, 蘑菇, 暴发户
vi. 迅速生长, 迅速增加, 采蘑菇
a. 蘑菇形的, 迅速生长的

mushroom coral.translation: [网络] 蘑菇珊瑚；蘑菇珊瑚-石芝珊瑚科

mushroom growth.translation: 雨后春笋般增长,迅速发展

mushroomed.definition:
v pick or gather mushrooms
v grow and spread fast
mushroomed.translation: vi. 迅速增长（mushroom的过去式与过去分词形式）

mushrooming.definition:
v pick or gather mushrooms
v grow and spread fast
mushrooming.translation: vi. 迅速延烧；激烈增殖；迅速增长；呈蘑菇状升腾（mushroom的现在分词形式）

mushrooms.definition:
n common name for an edible agaric (contrasting with the inedible toadstool)
n mushrooms and related fleshy fungi (including toadstools, puffballs, morels, coral fungi, etc.)
n any of various fleshy fungi of the subdivision Basidiomycota consisting of a cap at the end of a stem arising from an underground mycelium
n a large cloud of rubble and dust shaped like a mushroom and rising into the sky after an explosion (especially of a nuclear bomb)
n fleshy body of any of numerous edible fungi
v pick or gather mushrooms
v grow and spread fast
mushrooms.translation: n. 蘑菇；蕈类（mushroom的复数形式）

mushtaq.translation: n. (Mushtaq)人名；(阿拉伯、孟、巴基)穆什塔克

mushy.definition: s. having the consistency of mush
mushy.translation: a. 浓粥状的, 含糊不清, 感伤的
